label: Search Result Rows
summary: All result rows in the search-results table.

label: Nth Search Result Row
summary: Nth result row; use .locator('td').nth(1) for the 'Offer Sent On' column (index 1).
note: Column 'Offer Sent On' is hardcoded at index 1; caller must pass the row index i.

label: Record Field — th Label Strategy
summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 1: label in <th>, value in the next sibling <td>.

label: Record Field — td Label Strategy (Fallback)
summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 2 (fallback): label in <td>, value in the next sibling <td>.

label: Record Field — Any-Cell Label Strategy (Broader Fallback)
summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 3: label in any cell (<th> OR <td>) via .or() chain, value in next sibling <td>.
note: UNVERIFIED against live CRM — added 2026-06-07 as strictly-additive widening; needs live re-verify.

label: Record Field — Row-Scoped Last-Cell Strategy (Fallback)
summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 4: finds <tr> containing the label, reads its last <td> — robust when extra spacer cells separate label from value.
note: UNVERIFIED against live CRM — added 2026-06-07; handles label text split across child nodes via :has-text accumulation.

label: Record Field — Salesforce Lightning Fallback
summary: Salesforce Lightning record-detail fallback: reads .slds-form-element__control for a matching .slds-form-element__label.
note: UNVERIFIED against live CRM — added 2026-06-07; catches record pages served by Lightning UI instead of classic Visualforce.

label: Navigate to Section by Name
summary: Click a named CRM section via a fallback chain: link → plain text → tab.
note: Fallback chain: getByRole('link', regex) .or(getByText) .or(getByRole('tab', regex)); regex not escaped for special chars; CRM_SECTION_URLS direct-URL map covers only 'UCPath Entry Sheet' — missing sections fall through to this click path.
